title.zh: 元素周期律 · 周期表上的渐变
title.en: Periodic Trends · Gradients Across the Periodic Table

desc.zh: 把原子半径、电离能、电负性涂成热图：沿周期、沿族有规律的渐变，由核电荷和电子层数解释，也有少数例外。
desc.en: Colour atomic radius, ionisation energy and electronegativity onto the table: they change in regular gradients along periods and groups, explained by nuclear charge and the number of shells, with a few exceptions.
